game: Wake Forest Demon Deacons@California Golden Bears

guide_enrichment.narrative:
Our view starts with the ground game. Our matchup data gives Wake Forest a meaningful rushing advantage against California’s defense, while California faces the opposite problem against a strong Wake Forest run defense. Gio Lopez added 98 rushing yards and two touchdowns through his first two games, and Ty Clark III produced 141 yards on 19 carries. That gives Wake Forest a plausible way to sustain offense and make it harder for California to create separation.

California’s clearest counter is through the air and in scoring territory. Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele left the UNLV game with an injury, and the guide does not provide a later status, but Jackson Brousseau completed 19 of 32 passes for 200 yards and two touchdowns in relief. California also posted a .938 red-zone scoring rate through five games, while Wake Forest allowed points on each of its first 10 opponent red-zone possessions.

For us, the disagreement with the market is modest because the matchup pulls in both directions. Wake Forest’s rushing path challenges the expected margin, but California has a passing and red-zone route to separation. Our numbers do not create enough distance from the market to justify the available price.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch:
We are watching Wake Forest’s rushing offense against California’s rush defense. Lopez and Clark give Wake Forest multiple sources of production on the ground, and success there would reduce the need to challenge a California pass defense that ranked second in the ACC in efficiency through five games.

If California can force Wake Forest away from that strength and into obvious passing situations, we think the matchup becomes much more favorable for the home defense. If it cannot, Wake Forest has the clearest football-based route to staying competitive.

recent_game.fact: Wake Forest defeated Purdue 38-36 in double overtime on Sept. 12, 2026, improving to 2-0.
On fourth-and-15 in the second overtime, Gio Lopez completed a 15-yard pass to Carlos Hernandez; Lopez then scored the tying touchdown and the game-winning two-point conversion.
Wake Forest committed no turnovers against Purdue.
Purdue quarterback Ryan Browne passed for 329 yards, and running back Fame Ijeboi rushed 27 times for 114 yards and three touchdowns against Wake Forest.

opponent_notes.fact: California was listed with a 1-1 record when this Week 3 guide was published.

quarterback.fact: Gio Lopez started Wake Forest's first two games and completed 37 of 59 passes for 575 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing for 98 yards and two touchdowns.
Against Purdue, Lopez completed 16 of 27 passes for 225 yards and one touchdown and led Wake Forest with 59 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns.
Lopez transferred to Wake Forest from North Carolina after the 2025 season; he previously played at South Alabama under current Wake Forest offensive coordinator Rob Ezell.
While playing for North Carolina against California in 2025, Lopez completed 19 of 35 passes for 167 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed five times for 11 yards.
